tried: The workbook could not be fetched from a www.who.int page (cross-origin), so the browser was pointed at the cdn.who.int folder and the file fetched from the same origin and parsed in the page with SheetJS; no file was saved to disk.

Sheets present: Notes, Top20, Summary, and one sheet per region and year for Global, AFR, AMR, EMR, EUR, SEAR and WPR in 2000, 2010, 2015, 2019, 2020, 2021, 2022 and 2023. The 2020 and 2022 sheets were not transcribed (the task asked for 2019, 2021 and 2023).

The 2021-release and 2019-release regional workbooks are no longer linked from the page (only the 2023 release, dated September 2026, and a GHE2016 .xls), so the rounded report figures could not be matched against their own vintage here.
notes: The task asked whether the unrounded 2021 values match the 2024 report's rounded figures. They do not, and WHO says they should not: the only regional workbook now served is the GHE 2023 release (September 2026), whose Notes sheet says the estimates are not comparable to previously released ones. In that release, 2021 drowning deaths are Global 319,879; Western Pacific 95,882; South-East Asia 94,187; Africa 69,522; Eastern Mediterranean 23,775; Americas 19,541; Europe 16,972 — against the report's GHE 2021 figures of 300,000 (300,228); 84,000; 83,000; 66,000; 35,000; 17,000; 15,000. Europe, for example, moved from 15,000 to 16,972, the Eastern Mediterranean from 35,000 to 23,775. The cause row is GHE code 1570 "Drowning", group 5 under Unintentional injuries; the workbook does not print ICD codes, so the W65–W74 mapping rests on the GHE methods paper the ledger already cites. Counts are model outputs stored with decimals; rows give the cell value and the nearest whole death. Rates: the Summary sheet prints a crude death rate for 2023 only (Global 4.01; Africa 5.96; South-East Asia 4.95; Western Pacific 4.22; Eastern Mediterranean 3.44; Americas 1.90; Europe 1.97 per 100 000); for 2019 and 2021 the region sheets print deaths and population (thousands) but no rate, and none was computed. Nothing was summed across regions: the Global rows are the workbook's own Global sheets. Reviewer: a companion bundle from an independent agent for this task records the GHE 2019-release regional statements and corrections to who-region-eur's placeholder source and url; this bundle adds the workbook values only.
